knowledge:
- key_parameters: log_transform=TRUE = when set to TRUE during Moanin object creation, many downstream functions will internally use the log(x+1) transformation on the assay data for computations and visualizations ;; use_voom_weights=TRUE = used in DE_timepoints and DE_timecourse to apply upperquartile normalization and voom weights via limma for low-count RNA-Seq data; should only be used if input data are raw counts ;; type = parameter in create_timepoints_contrasts that controls contrast type, such as "per_timepoint_group_diff" (group differences per timepoint), "per_group_timepoint_diff" (timepoint differences within a group), or "group_and_timepoint_diff" (interaction of group and timepoint differences) ;; method = parameter in estimate_log_fold_change specifying the method for estimating log-fold change across time points (e.g., "sum" for sum of absolute differences) ;; smooth=TRUE = parameter in plot_splines_data to fit and plot smooth spline curves instead of raw data points
- alternatives: limma::makeContrasts = mentioned as the underlying manual contrast creation method which create_timepoints_contrasts automates ;; DE_timepoints vs DE_timecourse = weekly analysis (DE_timepoints) can be hard to interpret with low/varying replicates, whereas spline fitting (DE_timecourse) fits a smooth curve to model overall temporal differences
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing long time-course gene expression data (especially RNA-Seq counts) with multiple conditions/groups and multiple time points, where you want to find genes with different temporal profiles or cluster genes by their expression trajectories.
- pitfalls: Using use_voom_weights=TRUE on data that is already log-transformed or normalized (it expects raw counts or count-scale data) ;; Performing weekly DE analysis (DE_timepoints) when some time points have very few replicates (e.g., single observations), which is not statistically appropriate ;; Failing to set log_transform=TRUE during Moanin object creation when working with raw RNA-Seq counts, which is necessary for downstream spline fitting and visualization functions to correctly log-transform the data.

workflows.name: weekly_timepoint_de
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis comparing conditions or timepoints at individual weekly intervals using limma and voom weights.
input: preData (matrix of raw gene expression counts)
preMeta (data frame of sample metadata containing group and time variables)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a Moanin model object using create_moanin_model ;; 2. Generate timepoint contrasts using create_timepoints_contrasts ;; 3. Run weekly differential expression analysis using DE_timepoints
workflows.code:
moaninObject <- create_moanin_model(data=preData, meta=preMeta, 
                            group_variable="Condition", time_variable="Week")
preContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(moaninObject,"Preflowering", "Control")
postContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(
    moaninObject, "Postflowering", "Control" )
prepostContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(
    moaninObject, "Postflowering", "Preflowering")
weeklyPre <- DE_timepoints(moaninObject[1:500,], 
    contrasts=c(preContrasts,postContrasts,prepostContrasts),
     use_voom_weights=TRUE)
preDiffContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(
    moaninObject, "Preflowering" ,type="per_group_timepoint_diff")
preGroupDiffContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(
    moaninObject, "Preflowering", "Control" ,type="group_and_timepoint_diff")
preGroupDiffContrasts <- create_timepoints_contrasts(
    moaninObject, "Preflowering", "Control" ,
    type="group_and_timepoint_diff",timepoints_before=c(6,8),timepoints_after=c(8,9))
weeklyGroupDiffPre <- DE_timepoints(moaninObject[1:500,], 
    contrasts=preGroupDiffContrasts,
     use_voom_weights=TRUE)

workflows.name: spline_timecourse_de_and_clustering
workflows.intent: Fit smooth splines to model gene expression trajectories over time, perform spline-based differential expression, estimate log-fold changes, visualize trajectories, and cluster genes.
input: preData (matrix of raw gene expression counts)
preMeta (data frame of sample metadata containing group and time variables)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a Moanin model object using create_moanin_model ;; 2. Perform spline-based differential expression using DE_timecourse ;; 3. Estimate log-fold changes across the time-course using estimate_log_fold_change ;; 4. Visualize top genes using plot_splines_data ;; 5. Cluster trajectories using splines_kmeans ;; 6. Score and assign additional genes to clusters using splines_kmeans_score_and_label
workflows.code:
moaninObject <- create_moanin_model(data=preData, meta=preMeta, 
                            group_variable="Condition", time_variable="Week")
timecourseContrasts <- c("Preflowering-Control",
			 "Postflowering-Control",
			 "Postflowering-Preflowering")
splinePre <- DE_timecourse(moaninObject[1:500,], contrasts=timecourseContrasts,
     use_voom_weights=TRUE)
log_fold_change_timepoints <- estimate_log_fold_change(
    moaninObject[1:500,], contrasts=timecourseContrasts, method="sum")
whSig <- which(splinePre[,"Preflowering-Control_qval"]<0.05)
deGenes <- order(abs(
    log_fold_change_timepoints)[whSig,"Preflowering-Control"],
    decreasing=TRUE)[1:10]
plot_splines_data(moaninObject[whSig, ][deGenes,],
    smooth=TRUE, mar=c(1.5,2.5,2,0.1))
kmeans_clusters <- splines_kmeans(moaninObject[1:500,], n_clusters=3,
    random_seed=42, 
    n_init=20)
plot_splines_data(
    data=kmeans_clusters$centroids, moaninObject,
    smooth=TRUE)
scores_and_labels <- splines_kmeans_score_and_label(
    object=moaninObject,data=preData[1:2000,], kmeans_clusters=kmeans_clusters)
